meta.title: Watrana Rentals IPO: ₹1.47 Lakh SME Lot & 10% GMP Reality
meta.instagramCaption:
Zepto, Blinkit aur Amazon ke warehouses me forklifts rent par dene wali company Watrana Rentals ka IPO aa chuka hai! Lekin kya isme ₹1.5 Lakh lagana safe hai? 👇

Key Breakdown:
⚡ ₹120 Cr SME Issue: Quick-commerce boom se inki forklifts aur cranes ki rental demand kafi fast grow kar rahi hai!
⚠️ Massive ₹1.47 Lakh Lot Size: Normal IPO ki tarah ₹15,000 nahi, seedha ₹1,47,000 block honge! Plus machinery ke liye bhari bank debt hai!
🚨 Weak 10% GMP: Sirf ₹14,000 ke gain ke liye dedh lakh rupaye risk par lagana 100% dangerous hai!

Golden SME Rule: Jab tak GMP 30% ke upar na ho, tab tak retail capital safe rakho! Kya aap apply karoge? Comments me batao! 👇
